redCandidate.setup: The public runner receives a verified temporary two-task local manifest, ready fake browser, fake client, local artifact collection, and a fake estimator that returns 11 USD only for the first Codex baseline task against the 10 USD shared cap. Every other task costs and spends 0.1 USD.
redCandidate.expected: The cost-limited job records one redacted cost_limit artifact, launches neither of its tasks, and leaves the other five jobs to complete their two selected tasks under the shared spend boundary.
redCandidate.observed: The runner exits with Error: GAIA live task cost estimate exceeds remaining spend before it returns artifacts for the other jobs.
redCandidate.failureReason: The per-task catch writes an artifact and rethrows the budget exception, which terminates the complete nested job loop instead of isolating the affected arm.
